---
title: "PharmaStatsR Dashboard"
output: flexdashboard::flex_dashboard
runtime: shiny
---

```{r global, include=FALSE}
library(PharmaStatsR)
```

## Dataset Preview

```{r}
inputPanel(
  selectInput("dataset", "Choose dataset:",
              choices = c("pharma_sample", "pharma_survival"))
)

renderTable({
  ds <- get(input$dataset, asNamespace("PharmaStatsR"))
  head(ds)
})
```

## Plot

```{r}
renderPlot({
  ds <- get(input$dataset, asNamespace("PharmaStatsR"))
  if ("response" %in% names(ds)) {
    hist(ds$response, main = "Response Distribution")
  } else if ("time" %in% names(ds)) {
    plot(ds$time, ds$status, main = "Time vs Status")
  }
})
```
